baseline_reproduction_1M.purpose: Reproduce the original 250-query held-out run on PG 17.10
baseline_reproduction_1M.result_summary: All strategies ~98-114ms; ANN recall near 1.0; adaptive selects IVFFLAT_HYBRID and VECTOR_FIRST_HNSW (not SQL_FIRST). Differs from original because HNSW graph quality is better in this environment.

param_sweep_200K.purpose: Sweep HNSW ef_search and IVFFLAT probes on the 200K subset
param_sweep_200K.result_summary: HNSW_HYBRID and IVFFLAT_HYBRID achieve recall 1.0 at all parameter settings. VECTOR_FIRST_HNSW fails (recall 0.27) due to small candidate budget.

admission_policy_comparison.purpose: Compare 4 admission policies (min_recall, mean_recall, lcb_recall, quantile_recall)
admission_policy_comparison.result_summary: All 4 policies give the same result on 200K: IVFFLAT_HYBRID for all queries. Policies would diverge on harder workloads.

admission_policies.lcb_recall: bootstrap 95% lower confidence bound on Rmean >= 0.95
